## Où j'en suis
Staging is on PostgreSQL 17.2 via blue/green switchover (41 s of refused writes at 14:20 UTC): pg_partman was upgraded 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 with maintenance green on events_raw and events_daily, logical replication was enabled with a reboot, and dbt passes (14/14, +3% runtime, within noise). Runbook updated so step 0 for prod is "set rds.logical_replication = 1 and reboot". Commits 7e3c9d4 (logical replication in the module) and b0f18a2 (staging engine 17.2) pushed to draft PR #57. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 still open in draft; one full week of staging on 17 required before prod sign-off, earliest sign-off Nov 24 (source: src-pr57, ses-pg-3, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] watch staging for incidents during the week, then pick the production window with Maya after her sign-off; prod needs its own reboot window for rds.logical_replication before the blue/green (source: ses-pg-3, src-linear-kes298)
- [essai-raté] first terraform apply failed: RDS blue/green requires rds.logical_replication = 1 in the source parameter group, which is a static parameter needing a reboot (fixed on staging with a 1m48s reboot) (source: s3-04, s3-06)
- [essai-raté] terraform init -upgrade pulled AWS provider v6 with 37 unrelated changes; provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: s1-01, s1-02)
- [question] production window not chosen yet; earlier agent suggestion of Saturday Nov 28 04:00 UTC was retracted and a note claims it was decided, but Maya wants to pick the window only after a full week of staging without incident (source: s1-04, src-note-cutover, src-linear-kes298)
- [décision] no prod date until Maya signs off, apply_immediately stays false, and prod cutover must avoid the dbt lock on events_daily (01:00–03:30 UTC) (source: s1-04, src-linear-kes298)
